<!--
Routing:
- If your idea adds, changes, or removes a Layer-2 primitive, use the "Primitive proposal" template instead.
- If your idea changes ANY specification semantics (composition rules, profile contracts, schemas), this needs an RFC — see docs/rfcs/0001-rfc-process.md. Open this issue to discuss the rough shape first if you like, but the decision happens in the RFC.
- For non-spec features (CLI ergonomics, validator output format, LLM-bridge prompt examples, doc tooling, examples for an existing profile), this is the right place.
-->
